en.title: Find Given Words Along a Row or a Column
en.description:
For each word, independently determine whether it appears as a contiguous segment of some row or some column of the grid, read either forward or backward. It cannot turn or go diagonally, and matching is case-sensitive.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: The input is a JSON array [gridRows,words]. The original had no numeric bounds; this site adds 1≤number of rows, number of columns≤200, with all rows of equal length in Unicode code points; 0≤number of words≤200, each word 1..200 code points, and total word length ≤40000. Characters are arbitrary Unicode scalar values, including whitespace, NUL, and non-BMP characters; lone surrogates are not allowed. The whole JSON is ≤1000000 UTF-8 bytes, and the generator uses ASCII escapes so that control characters are carried intact.
en.output: Output Yes or No for each query in order, separated by spaces or newlines; if there are no queries, output an empty line.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: Yes Yes No; Yes Yes Yes; empty text. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Precompute all rows, all columns, and their reversed strings. Build a KMP prefix table for each word and search these strings one by one; cache the results of repeated queries for the same word.
